input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§2(d)) confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface and says nothing about our side of the line. There is no affirmative statement that Client retains all right, title and interest in Client Content, Client Intellectual Property or the borrower/loan data transmitted through the Interface (Client Content ownership is acknowledged only on discontinuation of hosting, in §13), and no ownership or licence provision for the results of the Support Services (i.e., the programming customization work we pay for) — §§10(b) and 10(c) treat those results only as confidential/Client Proprietary Information, which is not ownership. Combined with §8(d), under which Client grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to "use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" Credit Data, the agreement leaves our data and paid-for work product without any ownership anchor, failing the fallback (which at minimum requires a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the deliverables) on a material term. We therefore inserted a minimal ownership clause: Client retains all rights in its content, IP and data (expressly preserving the existing §8(d) Credit Data licence bargain), Support Services results are assigned to Client with a perpetual licence back for any embedded TrueLink IP, TrueLink's Interface ownership is preserved, and no joint ownership is created.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. As between the parties, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client Intellectual Property, and all data submitted to or transmitted through the Interface or the Web Site by or on behalf of Client or its customers or brokers (including Credit Data, subject only to the nonexclusive license granted in Section 8(d)). All results of the Support Services and any customizations, modifications, programs or other materials created by TrueLink specifically for Client hereunder shall be the sole property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest therein. TrueLink retains all ownership rights in the TrueLink Intellectual Property and the Interface, and to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such results, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the same in connection with Client's business. Nothing herein creates any joint ownership of, or any right of TrueLink in, Client Content, Client Intellectual Property or Client's data.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an ownership provision confirming that Client retains all rights in Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and data submitted through the Interface, and that customizations and other results of the Support Services are owned by Client with a licence back of any embedded TrueLink IP. Our playbook requires us to own what we pay for and everything we put in, with no assignment or joint ownership of our IP or data; TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is expressly preserved. If ownership of customizations is an issue, we can accept TrueLink ownership of generic tools plus a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the results for our business.
proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of Client Content, data and Support Services work product, with licence back of embedded TrueLink IP and no joint ownership.
